title: Olive-Shaped Chiral Supramolecules: Simultaneous Self-Assembly of Heptameric Lanthanum Clusters and Carbon Dioxide Fixation

material_class.structural_family: olive-shaped heptanuclear La7 cluster with carbonate-templated homochiral triple helix

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of LiOH·H2O (8.4 mg, 0.2 mmol) and (S)-H2L (23.8 mg, 0.1 mmol) in methanol (3 mL) was stirred for 5 min to give a transparent solution. A solution of La(NO3)3·6H2O (43.3 mg, 0.1 mmol) in methanol (2 mL) was added and the mixture was rapidly stirred for 10 min. Colorless rhombohedral crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray analysis formed by slow evaporation of methanol over two weeks at room temperature in air (67% yield). The crystals are soluble in water but insoluble in common organic solvents.
synthesis.time: stir 5 min then 10 min; slow evaporation over two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing and slow evaporation in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless rhombohedral crystals obtained by slow evaporation of methanol in air over two weeks.

properties.summary: Solid-state CD of 1 in a KBr disk is the mirror image of enantiomer 2, showing that ligand chirality is transferred to a homochiral crystal of one helical sense. IR carbonate bands near 1450 cm−1 and a solid-state 13C NMR peak at δ = 170.77 ppm confirm encapsulated CO3^2−. UV/Vis changes upon bubbling CO2 into the La/(S)-L2− methanol solution under inert atmosphere show atmospheric CO2 capture and conversion to the carbonate cluster. Optical rotation of the aqueous La/(S)-L2− system responds selectively to CO3^2− among several anions.

measurements.name: solid-state CD spectrum
measurements.value: mirror-image Cotton effects versus complex 2 (opposite sign)
measurements.conditions: transparent KBr disk, radius 5 mm; 3 mg of 1 mixed with 100 mg KBr

source_locations.location: Figure 3 CD; IR/NMR/UV-Vis discussion; Figure 4 optical rotation

material_class.structural_family: olive-shaped heptanuclear La7 cluster with carbonate-templated homochiral triple helix (P helix)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same procedure as 1 using (R)-H2L (23.8 mg, 0.1 mmol) instead of (S)-H2L, i.e. LiOH·H2O (8.4 mg, 0.2 mmol) and (R)-H2L in methanol (3 mL), then La(NO3)3·6H2O (43.3 mg, 0.1 mmol) in methanol (2 mL). During crystal growth the mixed solution was placed in a sealed tank filled with CO2; colorless rhombohedral crystals formed over two days (59% yield).
synthesis.time: slow evaporation over two days under CO2
synthesis.vessel_or_method: same mixing procedure as 1; crystallization in a sealed tank filled with CO2
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless rhombohedral crystals obtained by slow evaporation of methanol over two days in a sealed CO2-filled tank.

properties.summary: Solid-state CD of 2 in KBr is the exact mirror image of 1, consistent with the opposite P helical arrangement of the six (R)-L ligands around the carbonate core. Strong IR carbonate vibrations near 1450 cm−1 are also observed for 2.

measurements.name: solid-state CD spectrum
measurements.value: mirror-image Cotton effects versus complex 1 (opposite sign)
measurements.conditions: transparent KBr disk, radius 5 mm; 3 mg of 2 mixed with 100 mg KBr
